mechanism: 终身潜伏；免疫功能变化时可能再激活。
Lifelong latency with possible reactivation when immune control changes.
progress: 已建立：诊断和支持治疗；所引CDC资料未列特异治疗。
Established: diagnosis and supportive care; cited CDC guidance lists no specific treatment.
future: 编辑归纳：预防、长期疾病关联及高风险人群管理。
Editorial priorities: prevention, long-term disease associations and high-risk care.

structure: 有包膜；二十面体衣壳及被膜蛋白层。
Enveloped, with an icosahedral capsid and tegument.
receptor: PDGFRα与Neuropilin-2是已鉴定受体；Neuropilin-2参与上皮/内皮细胞感染。受体作用具有细胞背景依赖性。
PDGFRα and neuropilin-2 are identified receptors; neuropilin-2 participates in epithelial/endothelial infection. Receptor roles depend on cellular context.
symptoms: 通常无症状；可发热、乏力，免疫低下者可累及器官。
Usually asymptomatic; fever, fatigue or organ disease in immunocompromised people.
transmission: 唾液、尿液等体液，母婴传播及移植相关传播。
Bodily fluids, maternal transmission and transplant-related transmission.
risk: 先天感染相关听力损失；免疫低下者严重器官疾病。
Congenital hearing loss and serious organ disease in immunocompromised people.
prevention: 减少接触幼儿唾液和尿液，做好手卫生。
Reduce exposure to young children’s saliva/urine and practice hand hygiene.
treatment: 健康者通常不需治疗；部分先天感染或免疫低下患者需抗病毒药。
Healthy people usually need no therapy; selected congenital or immunocompromised cases need antivirals.
mechanism: 终身潜伏、再激活；胎内感染可影响发育。
Lifelong latency and reactivation; prenatal infection may impair development.
progress: 已建立：部分有症状先天感染可从抗病毒治疗获益，需监测副作用。
Established: selected symptomatic congenital cases benefit from antivirals, with toxicity monitoring.
future: 编辑归纳：母婴预防、早期识别和长期听力随访。
Editorial priorities: maternal prevention, early detection and long-term hearing follow-up.

structure: 无包膜；二十面体衣壳，环状DNA。
Non-enveloped, icosahedral capsid containing circular DNA.
receptor: 硫酸乙酰肝素蛋白聚糖（HSPGs）是若干生殖器HPV的附着因子；不能据此认定它是所有类型充分的进入受体。
Heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs) are attachment factors for several genital HPV types; they are not established as sufficient entry receptors for every type.
symptoms: 通常无症状；某些类型造成疣，持续高危感染可致癌。
Usually asymptomatic; some types cause warts, while persistent high-risk infection can cause cancer.
transmission: 亲密皮肤黏膜接触，生殖器感染通常经性接触。
Intimate skin/mucosal contact; genital infection commonly through sex.
risk: 宫颈癌及其他肛门生殖器或口咽癌。
Cervical and other anogenital or oropharyngeal cancers.
prevention: 接种疫苗，按建议筛查；安全性行为降低风险。
Vaccination, recommended screening and safer sex.
treatment: 治疗疣、癌前病变或癌症；没有清除所有HPV感染的药物。
Treat warts, precancer or cancer; no medicine eradicates all HPV infections.
mechanism: 持续高危感染可扰乱细胞生长调控，逐渐形成癌前病变。
Persistent high-risk infection can disrupt growth regulation and lead to precancer.
progress: 已建立：预防疫苗与筛查共同支持宫颈癌消除。
Established: preventive vaccination and screening support cervical cancer elimination.
future: 编辑归纳：覆盖公平、筛查可及性和治疗性干预。
Editorial priorities: equitable coverage, accessible screening and therapeutic interventions.

structure: 无包膜；小型二十面体衣壳。
Non-enveloped, small icosahedral capsid.
receptor: Globoside（P抗原）是重要宿主因子，但不是充分的表面进入受体；2024年研究支持其细胞内作用，提示旧的一受体模型需更新。
Globoside (P antigen) is an important host factor, not a sufficient surface entry receptor. A 2024 study supports an intracellular role, refining older single-receptor models.
symptoms: 发热、关节痛和拍击样面颊红疹；可无症状。
Fever, joint pain and a slapped-cheek rash; sometimes asymptomatic.
transmission: 呼吸颗粒、血液及孕期母胎传播。
Respiratory particles, blood and maternal–fetal transmission.
risk: 基础血液病或免疫低下者贫血；胎儿贫血及妊娠损失。
Anemia in blood disorders or immunodeficiency; fetal anemia and pregnancy loss.
prevention: 呼吸与手卫生；孕期暴露咨询医生。
Respiratory/hand hygiene and clinician advice after pregnancy exposure.
treatment: 轻症对症支持；严重贫血或孕期感染需专科处理。
Supportive care for mild disease; specialist management for severe anemia or pregnancy infection.
mechanism: 感染影响红细胞生成，部分症状与免疫反应有关。
Infection affects red-cell production; immune responses contribute to some symptoms.
progress: 已建立：无常规疫苗，重在识别高风险暴露和并发症。
Established: no routine vaccine; identify high-risk exposures and complications.
future: 编辑归纳：孕期筛查策略、高风险随访和预防工具。
Editorial priorities: pregnancy screening strategies, high-risk follow-up and preventive tools.
